₹600 – 1.500 INR

Đã đăng2 phút trước

Requirement: Skincare Product Mono Carton Packaging Designer I’m looking for a graphic/packaging designer to design the mono carton (outer packaging box) for my skincare brand, A’me. I want the packaging to have a premium, elegant, minimal, and modern aesthetic that aligns with my brand identity and the product packaging. The design should look sophisticated, clean, and visually appealing, with a luxury skincare feel. Scope of Work: * Design the outer mono carton packaging for my skincare product. * Design all sides of the box, including the front, back, sides, top, and bottom. * Incorporate the brand logo, product name, ingredients, product description, usage instructions, and other required information. * Create a visually cohesive layout with suitable typography, colours, and design elements. * Provide a print-ready design with the correct dieline, dimensions, bleed, and finishing specifications. * Provide final high-resolution files and editable source files. I would prefer someone with experience in cosmetic, skincare, beauty, or premium product packaging design who understands how to create packaging that looks high-end and professional. Budget: ₹300 per design. Please share your portfolio and relevant packaging design work.

WordPress Mobile Speed Optimisation

$30 – 250 USD

Đã đăng7 phút trước

My WordPress site — www.zenithlaser.co.nz — is online and functional, but on phones the pages crawl. I want you to dig in, trim the fat and get it flying. Primary objective Speed matters most. Faster loading and better mobile use are the key outcomes, with the slow-phone issue top of the list. Scope of work • Audit current performance with PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse or similar and share the baseline numbers. • Identify and safely remove redundant or conflicting plugins. • Optimise images, caching, CSS/JS delivery and database overhead. • Ensure layouts, buttons and text remain crisp on all modern mobile devices. • Run a quick SEO health check once the clean-up is complete so nothing critical is broken in the process. Deliverables 1. Pre- and post-optimisation speed reports. 2. List of plugins removed or replaced and the rationale for each. 3. Summary of changes applied (caching, compression, minification, etc.). 4. Final mobile and desktop performance scores, with targets met or exceeded. Please respond with a detailed project proposal outlining your approach, timeline and any similar results you have achieved.

AWS & Azure DevOps Specialist

$30 – 250 USD

Đã đăng8 phút trước

I manage several production workloads split between AWS and Azure and I need an advanced DevOps engineer who can take full ownership of our cloud setup, automated deployment pipelines, and day-to-day monitoring, backup, and security tasks. The current stack relies heavily on web application servers and managed databases in AWS (EC2, ALB, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch) while parts of the newer services live in Azure (VM Scale Sets, Azure SQL, Application Gateway, Log Analytics). You’ll be working during Indian daytime hours so that we can collaborate in real time on architecture reviews, incident response, and sprint planning. Immediate priorities • Audit and harden both clouds, aligning security groups, NSGs, and backup policies • Streamline CI/CD so each commit ships through an automated pipeline (GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps are in place but need refinement) • Set up comprehensive monitoring with alerting thresholds that catch issues before customers do Test task Before we proceed to long-term engagement, I’ll assign a small paid exercise: migrate one existing AWS web tier to a blue-green deployment model, document the steps, and demonstrate zero downtime. Passing this task is mandatory and will be reviewed on call. Please apply only if you are truly senior with proven hands-on experience across BOTH AWS and Azure and can be online during IST. Share a brief note on similar projects and be ready to begin the test task as soon as we agree on access and NDA.

Fokus utamanya ialah: • Menulis teks iklan berasaskan jualan yang mampu menarik perhatian audiens sasaran dalam beberapa saat pertama. • Mengolah mesej menjadi ayat-ayat pendek yang jelas, disertakan panggilan bertindak (CTA) yang kuat. • Menyesuaikan nada dan gaya penulisan supaya selari dengan identiti jenama saya—mesra, meyakinkan, dan profesional. • Menyediakan beberapa variasi copy untuk tujuan A/B testing di Facebook, Instagram, dan mungkin juga salinan ringkas untuk halaman jualan pendek (landing page).
